scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8003
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.worker
scripts.typecheck:web: pnpm --filter web exec next typegen && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
